turns.user: Hôm nay GPT có gì mới
turns.assistant_text:
Tin lớn nhất hôm nay là OpenAI ra mắt **GPT-6 Cyber**, một mô hình AI chuyên về an ninh mạng. Ngoài ra có vài tin khác về ChatGPT và OpenAI.

### Tin chính: GPT-6 Cyber
- **Mục đích:** Tìm lỗ hổng phần mềm và kiểm tra xem lỗ hổng có thể bị khai thác thật hay không. OpenAI cũng muốn dùng nó để theo dõi các AI agent làm sai trong lĩnh vực an ninh mạng, phát hiện thông tin đăng nhập bị đánh cắp, phát hiện việc dùng sai mục đích và theo dõi các mối đe dọa mới.
- **Kết quả theo OpenAI:**
  - Tìm ra **81 lỗ hổng mới trong Firefox**. Một kỹ sư của Firefox xác nhận mô hình đã tìm được các lỗ hổng nghiêm trọng mà các đợt kiểm thử bằng AI trước đó bỏ sót.
  - Tái tạo được 1.724 lỗ hổng trong lõi Linux (Linux kernel) và viết được mã khai thác chạy được cho 948 lỗ hổng. Con số này **gấp hơn 5 lần GPT-5.6 Sol**.
  - Phát hiện lỗi nghiêm trọng trong Brotli, một thư viện nén dữ liệu mà Node.js cũng dùng.
  - Đã báo 304 lỗi nghiêm trọng cho nhóm duy trì Linux, kèm đề xuất cách sửa.
- **Ai được dùng:** Chưa mở cho mọi người. Chỉ một số khách hàng đã được duyệt trong chương trình **Daybreak Red** mới được dùng, để kiểm thử bảo mật có cho phép.
- OpenAI cho biết đã thêm các biện pháp an toàn mạnh hơn để ngăn mô hình bị dùng vào việc tấn công.

Nguồn: [BankInfoSecurity](https://www.bankinfosecurity.com/openai-unveils-gpt-6-cyber-stronger-exploit-skills-a-33314), [EdTech Innovation Hub](https://www.edtechinnovationhub.com/news/openais-gpt-6-cyber-finds-81-firefox-flaws-that-earlier-ai-testing-missed)

### Tin khác về ChatGPT và OpenAI
- **ChatGPT Enterprise đã có trên AWS Marketplace:** Doanh nghiệp có thể mua ChatGPT Enterprise qua AWS. Cách này bổ sung cho các mô hình OpenAI vốn đã có trên Amazon Bedrock. ([OpenAI](https://openai.com/index/chatgpt-enterprise-aws-marketplace))
- **Thương hiệu sẽ xem được mình được ChatGPT nhắc đến bao nhiêu:** OpenAI sắp cho các thương hiệu theo dõi số lần được nhắc trong câu trả lời của ChatGPT. Báo này cho rằng đây là cách để kiếm thêm tiền từ ngành tối ưu cho công cụ trả lời bằng AI (AEO). ([Tubefilter](https://www.tubefilter.com/2026/11/09/brand-mention-chatbot-chatgpt-openai-mentions))
- **OpenAI bị kiện:** Một người đàn ông ở bang North Carolina (Mỹ) cáo buộc ChatGPT đã giúp vợ anh lập kế hoạch đầu độc anh. OpenAI cho biết đã khóa tài khoản người dùng đó và cung cấp thông tin cho cơ quan điều tra. ([Insurance Journal](https://www.insurancejournal.com/news/southeast/2026/11/09/892144.htm))

Các con số về GPT-6 Cyber đều do OpenAI công bố, chưa có bên độc lập nào kiểm chứng.

items.title: OpenAI Unveils GPT-6 Cyber With Stronger Exploit Skills
items.summary:
The company said it envisions GPT-6 Cyber as an important tool for cyber-specific misalignment monitoring for agents, protecting against stolen credentials, identifying misuse and targeted monitoring of emerging threats. OpenAI said that it added stronger safeguards to help. [...] Credit Eligible

 OpenAI Unveils GPT-6 Cyber With Stronger Exploit Skills 

Image: Shutterstock

 

OpenAI's new cyber-capable artificial intelligence model, GPT-6 Cyber, found 81 new vulnerabilities in Firefox and claims it can spot and prevent attempts to turn it to malicious hacking.

See Also: Build vs. Buy: AI Penetration Testing [...] OpenAI researchers also "reproduced 1,724 vulnerabilities and developed working exploits for 948" Linux kernel vulnerabilities. They said this was "more than five times" the number exploited by GPT-5.6 Sol. The model detected critical weaknesses in Brotli, a compression library used by software including Node.js.

items.title: OpenAI says GPT-6 Cyber found 81 previously unknown Firefox flaws | ETIH EdTech News — EdTech Innovation Hub
items.summary:
Brian Grinstead, Distinguished Engineer at Firefox, says: “Even after further hardening with multiple generations of frontier models, GPT‑6 Cyber uncovered previously unknown high-severity vulnerabilities, identified architectural improvements, and helped us ship fixes to millions of users.”

The findings accompany a restricted rollout through Daybreak Red, OpenAI’s access program for more advanced exploit development and authorized security testing. [...] A shield and circuit pattern accompany ETIH’s coverage of OpenAI’s GPT-6 Cyber security model and its restricted Daybreak Red rollout.

OpenAI’s GPT-6 Cyber is initially available to select approved Daybreak Red customers. Conceptual illustration.

OpenAI is giving approved security teams access to GPT-6 Cyber, an AI model designed to find software vulnerabilities and demonstrate whether they can actually be exploited. [...] #### Finding flaws and demonstrating their impact

OpenAI says its researchers also used GPT-6 Cyber to develop working exploits for 948 Linux kernel vulnerabilities, producing code that demonstrates how the flaws can be used.

Following Linux community guidance, the company disclosed 304 critical findings to maintainers with proposed fixes. Work to address other vulnerabilities is continuing.

items.title: As brands dive into ChatGPT, OpenAI will let them track their mentions - Tubefilter
items.summary:
Subscribe

From a marketing standpoint, that’s a rudimentary level of analytics, but by showing brands their ChatGPT mentions, OpenAI can give them tangible evidence of the results of any marketing pushes they make on the platform. As answer engine optimization becomes a valuable marketing category — and the firms running AEO campaigns haul in big funding rounds — OpenAI is bringing improved measurement to that ecosystem. [...] If AI chatbots are going to remain a relevant touchpoint for marketers, then agencies and brands need access to the same analytics they use in their other campaigns. Rumor has it that OpenAIis developing new tools in that area, potentially creating new opportunities for advertisers on ChatGPT. [...] If ChatGPT’s brand dashboard is indeed a play for AEO dollars, it will help answer a question that has followed the chatbot ever since its 2023 ascension: What is the best way for OpenAI to monetize its prized technology? Despite early experiments like the GPT Store, ChatGPT’s share of the LLM market has been shrinking. To bring in more revenue, OpenAI started running ads for lower-tier ChatGPT users, even though CEO Sam Altmanpreviously expressed his distaste for that format.

items.title: ChatGPT Enterprise now available in AWS Marketplace
items.summary:
These OpenAI products complement the OpenAI models available in Amazon Bedrock. Developers can build AI applications and agents with OpenAI models in Amazon Bedrock, while teams across the business use ChatGPT Enterprise in their daily work. Organizations can choose the approach that fits their workloads and governance requirements.

1 of 3 [...] > “Enterprises increasingly rely on both AWS and OpenAI to put AI to work, and our partnership is about making that combination stronger for them. Joint customers can now bring ChatGPT to their teams through the cloud provider they already trust. Together with AWS, we’re simplifying the path to adoption and helping more organizations unlock what’s possible with AI at scale.”

—Chris Grusz, Managing Director, Cloud Partnerships, OpenAI

items.title: OpenAI Sued Over Claim That ChatGPT Drafted Lethal NC Poisoning Plan
items.summary:
November 9, 2026

Email This   Subscribe to Newsletter

 Article
 0 Comments

James Gates says he started to suspect his wife was trying to poison him after he found a handwritten note with a list of substances and dosage plans, some of which were labeled “lethal.”

At the top of the note were additional instructions: “clear all convos” and “log out of chat GPT,” according to a lawsuit Gates filed Thursday against OpenAI, the maker of the world’s most popular chatbot. [...] In ongoing lawsuits, OpenAI and other companies have defended themselves by arguing that content generated by chatbots is free speech and not subject to product liability laws. They’ve also denied that the chatbots are directly responsible for crimes committed by users.

“Safety is a top priority,” OpenAI said in a statement. “We banned this user and have provided information to law enforcement as part of their investigation into this case.”
